title: Scheduled Fourier coefficient estimator
statement: For a finite set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and rational parameters $\varepsilon,\delta\in(0,1/2]$, the scheduled Fourier coefficient estimator is the random-example learning program that runs the Fourier coefficient estimator on $S$ using the sample count prescribed by $\varepsilon$ and $\delta$, and returns a rational output.
hypotheses_covered: The program uses random-example access and returns a rational value
caveat: The defining expression refers to `fourierCoeffEstimatorProgram` and `fourierEstimatorSampleCount`, whose definitions are not included in the supplied context; the exact mathematical behavior of the estimator and sample-count rule cannot be stated from this payload alone.
